tools.name: explore_tree
tools.title: Explore a question
tools.description: MUST be called whenever the user asks to research, explore, investigate, assess, compare, or recommend about a substantive topic. Start an interactive sourced knowledge-tree investigation instead of answering from general knowledge. This returns before findings are available. After calling it, do not answer the research question or call any other tool in the same conversation turn. Depth and breadth must each be between 1 and 4.

objective.description: The decision, task, or outcome this research should support.

audience.description: Who will consume or act on the findings.

scope.description: Specific dimensions that the research must cover.

constraints.description: Boundaries, assumptions, exclusions, or requirements to respect.

freshness.description: How recent the evidence should be, such as 'last 12 months'.

desired_output.description: How the user intends to apply the research, such as an executive recommendation or comparison.

tools.name: expand_node
tools.title: Expand a research branch
tools.description: Expand a leaf node in an existing ExploreTree research session.

tools.name: add_followup
tools.title: Add a research follow-up
tools.description: Add a focused follow-up question below a node in an existing ExploreTree research session.

tools.name: get_research_results
tools.title: Get research results
tools.description: Retrieve the current status and compact sourced findings for a previously started ExploreTree session. Call only after the user sends a later message asking about that exploration. Never call in the same conversation turn as explore_tree.

session_id.description: The session identifier returned by explore_tree in an earlier conversation turn.

tools.name: get_tree_outline
tools.title: Get research tree outline
tools.description: Retrieve compact semantic metadata and stable node IDs for an existing ExploreTree session on a later user turn. Never call in the same conversation turn as explore_tree. Use this to resolve a branch mentioned by the user before expanding it, adding a follow-up, or requesting branch context.

tools.name: get_branch_context
tools.title: Get research branch context
tools.description: Retrieve compact sourced context for one or two branches in an existing ExploreTree session on a later user turn. Never call in the same conversation turn as explore_tree. Use two node IDs when the user asks to compare branches.

tools.name: get_node_media
tools.title: Load node media
tools.description: Load image and video references for an ExploreTree node.
